metrics.definitions: Pair onset after absence (contiguous repeats deduplicated); network-wide departures and arrivals over fixed simulation horizon, unfinished trips censored. AQL/AWT are group-time means of existing queue length/mean waiting time, speed is vehicle-time mean; not completed-trip delay.

inference.definition: Synchronized wall time includes histories, tensor assembly, transfers, forward and CPU score mapping. Percentiles cover retained calls; first-call costs are included. Amortized cost is not single-vehicle latency.
